classification.difficultyReason: Interpret each shaded region, identify its upper and lower functions and bounds, then evaluate the resulting exact trigonometric integral.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of the shaded region.

spec.description: Sine and cosine curves with continuation arrows, labelled axes and ticks, and the shaded region bounded by their intersection and x=pi/2. Meaningful source shading uses house light blue.
spec.mathematics: Region between sin x and cos x on pi/4 <= x <= pi/2, with sin x above cos x.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied question graph only; no calculated area.

spec.description: Both sine curves on [0,pi], dashed intersection guide at pi/3, filled endpoint at (pi,0), source ticks and pale blue first region.
spec.mathematics: Region between sin 2x and sin x on [0,pi/3], with sin 2x above sin x.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; no calculated area.

spec.description: Line and sine curve with continuation arrows, vertical boundary at pi/2, horizontal dashed guide at y=pi/2 and source axis labels.
spec.mathematics: Region between y=x and y=sin x on [0,pi/2], with the line above the curve.
spec.answerVisibility: Question givens and shaded region only.
